expected_deltas.rationale: Text entity value change beside a tagged instrument block.

Moved block reference (same block, same layer): exercises the geometry-aware match rule (plan §4.2), which must pair the two INSERTs by layer+entity+block despite the offset. The label text ('26BL9075') moves with it but keeps the same string, so it aligns as unchanged (correct: text-tier matching classifies same-text-different-position as unchanged, not modified) -- the reported delta is the geometry INSERT itself, whose canonical text is its block name. Corrected during Phase 10 eval: this entry originally listed the label text here, which the engine correctly never reports as a delta, producing a spurious false negative.

New valve insert + label + tie-in line (counted as the labelled valve, matching how the shared classifier tags '43BL9020' as element_type=valve via exact-key tier 1 -- not the geometry INSERT itself; the tie-in LINE is a second added geometry). Corrected during Phase 10 eval: this entry originally said element_type=geometry, which never matches the engine's actual (correct) classification.
Drain stub LINE removed; no text key -- only the geometry rule can catch it.

notes: A.dxf and B.dxf are authored programmatically (see scripts/synthesize_pairs.py::_author_pair3_drawing) because PDF->DXF conversion flattens text to outlines. The moved valve's LABEL text also moves with GT3-MOVE (same string, new position) -- position-only text moves are expected to align as unchanged-or-modified, never add/remove.
